title: Cheerly
summary: CHEERLY, adjective Gay; cheerful; not gloomy. CHEERLY, adverb Cheerfully; heartily; briskly. CHEERLY, adjective Gay; sprightly; having power to make gay. Come, let us hie, and quaff a cheery bowl.
